provenance_note: The wave-1 false positive: a Cloudflare-fronted app page that carries the ordinary JS-detections beacon AND ordinary prose containing 'Just a moment' (a loading hint, a noscript note). Beacon presence plus one prose phrase must never be a block (D13). The beacon path is measured (demo.usememos.com embeds it); the prose is written for the test.
body: Just a moment, loading your workspace...
